svg.title: The public boundary of DorkOS Cloud
svg.desc: Optional local Cloud clients use HTTPS. An older link client and the versioned public client coexist and resolve different origins. The versioned client resolves authenticated instance identity before minting scoped inference credentials under the same current link. A Runs on choice selects credits; the minted token's served list gates each runtime's request format, and the environment variable can only disable credits. The managed remote consumer is built and off until its switch is set. The public contract is a schema package, not deployment proof. Remote-access paths are a separate view.
